title: Holds on Specialty Pharmacy Program Enrollments
content:
## Causes of a hold

A Specialty Pharmacy Program enrollment goes on hold in the following circumstances. Each is recorded with the hold reason shown.

| Circumstance | Hold reason recorded |
|---|---|
| The member's plan coverage ends | coverage terminated |
| The coverage review approval the drug needs expires without renewal | coverage review expired |
| The member or the prescriber asks to pause because of a hospitalization, where the tier allows hospitalization holds | hospitalized |
| The member or the prescriber asks to pause because of a therapy break, where the tier allows such holds | therapy paused |
| The combined specialty balance stays above the specialty credit limit past the payment-due days | payment overdue |

## Clearing a hold

A hold is cleared, and the enrollment resumes, only when the hold's own cause is resolved:

- coverage terminated: coverage reinstated;
- coverage review expired: a new approval in force;
- hospitalized or therapy paused: the member or the prescriber confirming that therapy restarts.

The hold reason on the enrollment record identifies the cause. Whether that cause is resolved rests on the records, or, for a restart of therapy, on the confirmation of the member or the prescriber.

The listed resolution for a payment-overdue hold, *the balance brought to the credit limit or below*, is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded by the current rule on the hold-release payment.

## Maximum length of a hold

An enrollment still on hold after the tier's maximum hold, counted in calendar days with the hold start date as day zero, is discharged. A held enrollment may be discharged for length of hold only after that many calendar days have **fully elapsed** since the hold start date. On day N itself, where N is the maximum hold, the period has not fully elapsed. On the day after day N it has.

### Boundary cases (assumed hold start of June 10 and an assumed 60-day maximum)

| Today | Day count | May the enrollment be discharged for length of hold? |
|---|---|---|
| August 8 | day 59 | No |
| August 9 | day 60 | No, because the period has not fully elapsed |
| August 10 | day 61 | Yes |

## Point of judgement

*An enrollment is on hold for a hospitalization and the member's coverage review approval is renewed.* A new approval does not resolve a hospitalization hold. That hold's own cause is resolved by the member or the prescriber confirming that therapy restarts.
